entries.basis: MD-90-30 (V2525-D5, MTOW 156,000 lb). Range 2,045 nmi with 153 passengers = 0.5. Capacity 153-158 two-class = 2. Speed Mach 0.76 cruise = 2. Runway 7,000 ft at 156,000 lb, sea level, ISA (MD-90-30 airport-planning manual, via Wikipedia) = 4. Comfort null: three independent firsthand publishers now describe Delta MD-90 cabins, including economy and first class in different periods; these do not establish a universal launch-era comfort score. Efficiency null: Delta publishes no per-seat burn. AeroXplorer, AirlineReporter (2017) and Kinda Boring Travels (2020) are firsthand MD-90 reports; Simple Flying is supplemental history, not firsthand testing. The museum executive statement was removed from reviews but retained as a specification/history reference.
